genre.en: a car-magazine feature: the car on a real road or in a real workshop, golden-hour light, reflections in the paint

s: a hand-off of car keys from one palm to another in front of a used sedan's open driver door, a terracotta-orange roller shutter of a car workshop filling the background, hard late-afternoon sun from camera left throwing the key's and the hands' sharp shadows across the door panel

the front quarter of a used hatchback fills the frame in a lot-side repair bay with deep-sea-blue painted brick walls, a single hard sun shaft from the high right cutting a crisp diagonal shadow of the roofline across the bonnet

a seller and a buyer lean over an open engine bay together, close and large in frame, against a tomato-red garage door, hard side light from the open bay entrance carving long shadows of their arms across the engine
the rear of a used SUV with its tailgate open on a tarmac lot, a mint-green painted warehouse wall behind it, low hard sun from behind-left stretching the car's shadow toward the camera

a hand pressing a flashlight beam along a used car's door seam during a pricing inspection, the car's flank filling the frame against a deep-sea-blue garage wall, hard overhead bay light from the upper right throwing a sharp shadow of the hand and the door handle across the paint

the inspector crouches by a front wheel with a tire-tread gauge, the wheel arch and tire huge in frame, a terracotta-orange workshop shutter behind, hard low sun from the open door on the left casting long crisp shadows of the gauge across the tread

an open car door with a clipboard of inspection notes resting on the door sill, the interior and door filling the frame, a mint-green painted lot wall behind, hard noon sun from directly right projecting the clipboard's shadow across the seat

a hand holding up an odometer-lit dashboard through the windshield, the steering wheel and gauge cluster big in frame, a tomato-red wall reflected faintly beyond the glass, hard side sun from the left laying the steering-wheel spokes' shadow across the dash

the owner and the appraiser stand at the car's bonnet looking at the open engine bay, the bonnet edge large in the foreground, a deep-sea-blue shutter behind, hard afternoon light from the right throwing both of their shadows up the shutter

a row of three used cars nosed up to a terracotta-orange painted wall on a sunny lot, the nearest car's front end filling the frame, hard low sun from the left throwing long sharp shadows of all three across the asphalt

a salesperson opening a used car's driver door for a buyer to sit in, the open door and seat big in the foreground, a mint-green showroom-lot wall behind, hard morning sun from the right throwing the door's shadow across the ground

the headlight and grille of an imported used sedan filling the frame on an open-air lot, a deep-sea-blue storage container wall behind it, hard side sun from the upper left carving crisp shadows under the grille and bumper

a buyer's hand running along a used wagon's roof rail in a tomato-red-walled car yard, the roof and rail big in frame, hard overhead afternoon sun from the right casting the hand's long shadow down the window

the open trunk of a used SUV showing its clean cargo area, the trunk filling the frame, a terracotta-orange workshop wall behind, hard late sun from the left throwing the trunk lid's shadow deep into the cargo floor

two cars parked nose to tail, an old compact in front and a newer one behind, the old car's rear filling the frame against a deep-sea-blue lot wall, hard low sun from the left throwing both cars' sharp shadows across the concrete

an owner hands over the old car's keys while a new set of keys is passed back, both hands big in frame in front of a tomato-red painted garage door, hard late sun from the right casting the key and finger shadows across the door

the owner loading a last bag from the old car's boot into the new car beside it on a lot, the two open trunks large in frame, a mint-green wall behind, hard morning sun from the left laying long trunk-lid shadows across the ground

a trade-in car's registration paper held against the old car's windshield by a hand, windshield and hand filling the frame, a terracotta-orange workshop wall behind, hard noon sun from the right throwing the paper's crisp shadow across the dash

a new used-car's driver seat seen from the open door as the owner sits in for the first time, the door and seat big in the foreground, a deep-sea-blue garage wall beyond, hard side sun from the left casting the door frame's shadow across the seat

a hand holding a printed photo of a wanted car model up to a lot of real cars, the printout big in the foreground and the matching car sharp behind it, a terracotta-orange painted wall beyond, hard afternoon sun from the left throwing the printout's shadow across the hood

a car finder crouching to check the underbody of a candidate used car at a dealer yard, the bumper and wheel huge in frame, a deep-sea-blue container wall behind, hard low sun from the right casting a long crisp shadow of the finder across the gravel

a phone showing a car listing held beside the real car's door on a lot, phone and car door both large in frame, a tomato-red wall behind, hard side sun from the left laying the phone's sharp shadow across the door paint

a client stands beside the car just found for them, a hand on the roof, the car's side filling the frame in a mint-green-walled lot, hard late sun from behind-right throwing the car's and the client's shadows toward the camera

the open driver door of a located used car with the key in the ignition on a yard, the door and wheel big in the foreground, a terracotta-orange wall behind, hard noon sun from the right throwing the door's shadow across the gravel

two people lean over a car's bonnet with a printed price sheet laid on it, the bonnet and sheet filling the frame against a deep-sea-blue lot wall, hard afternoon sun from the left throwing the sheet's and the pen's sharp shadows across the paint

a hand pointing at the odometer through an open car door while another holds a calculator, the dash and door big in frame, a tomato-red wall behind, hard side sun from the right casting the hands' long shadows across the dash

two used cars of the same model parked side by side in a yard with different mileage stickers on the windshield, the nearer car's windshield filling the frame, a mint-green wall behind, hard low sun from the left throwing both cars' shadows long across the asphalt

an advisor and a buyer sit on the folding chairs beside a car at the lot's edge, the car's front fender large in the foreground, a terracotta-orange shutter behind, hard late sun from the right throwing the chairs' crisp shadows across the concrete

a notebook full of handwritten price comparisons resting on a used car's roof, the roof and notebook filling the frame, a deep-sea-blue garage wall beyond, hard overhead noon light from the left casting the pen's shadow across the page

two dealers shaking hands between a row of used cars in a trade lot, hands and cars large in frame, a tomato-red wall behind them, hard late sun from the left throwing their long shadows across the asphalt

a line of used cars lined nose to tail at a wholesale car yard, the nearest car's grille filling the frame, a deep-sea-blue container wall behind, hard low morning sun from the right carving long sharp shadows between the cars

a dealer's hand passing a stack of car keys to another dealer over a car's bonnet, keys and hands big in frame, a mint-green lot wall beyond, hard side sun from the left laying the key shadows across the paint

two dealers inspecting a shared-stock car's open engine bay together on a lot, their heads and the engine large in frame, a terracotta-orange shutter behind, hard noon light from the right throwing the bonnet's shadow across the engine

the rear of a car-carrier truck unloading a used sedan onto a lot, the sedan's front big in frame, a tomato-red painted fence behind, hard afternoon sun from the left throwing the ramp's and the sedan's long shadows across the ground
